sn46.18:1.1: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā || viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || ||
sn46.18:1.2: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || ||
sn46.18:1.5: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā || viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī || ||
sn46.18:1.6: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhagāmī ti || || 2.
